title: elymus semicostatus var. thomsonii
intro: Elymus semicostatus var. thomsonii, commonly known as blue wildrye, is a perennial grass species native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of blue wildrye are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that may help to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. Studies have shown that the bioactive compounds present in blue wildrye may also have antimicrobial and anticancer properties.
